questions.question: At which ground did Robin-Leigh Brooker record their career-best bowling figures (5-23, List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at City Oval, against Tuskers on 2013/11/10.

questions.question: Tazmin Brits set a database record (22/23 season, combined T20 + List A) with a value of 89. Which record is it?
questions.explanation: It's the record for 'Most Fours', held by Tazmin Brits.

questions.question: In head-to-head T20 meetings, who has the edge, Dolphins or Badgers?
Who holds the record for 'Best Batting Average' (combined T20 + List A)?
questions.explanation: Mignon du Preez holds it with 64.90.

questions.question: At Recreation Ground, who holds the record for 'Most Matches' (T20)?
questions.explanation: Micaela Andrews holds it with 26, a joint record shared with Jané Winster.

questions.question: "Tuskers" is the current name for which former provincial union?
questions.explanation: KwaZulu-Natal Inland was rebranded Tuskers (KwaZulu-Natal Coastal became the Dolphins).
